build_transformer_tower: build a Haiku Transformer tower with configurable layers, heads, and dropout for sequence modeling
create_transformer_with_embedder: create a Transformer module initialized with an input embedder and custom hyperparameters
run_transformer_forward_pass: run the Transformer forward pass on examples and labels with an optional attention mask
review_transformer_init_config: review the Transformer class init to configure num_layers, num_heads, and init scales
summarize_transformer_call: summarize the Transformer call method that encodes inputs through causal transformer blocks and conv1d
